passive_house_informed_guardrail.title: EPSM passive-house-informed exterior performance guardrail
passive_house_informed_guardrail.note: Modelling assumptions, not official Swedish certification thresholds or an economic optimum. FEBY evaluates whole-building heat losses rather than one universal element U-value set. Provisional benchmarks in W/(m2K): Roof 0.08, External Wall 0.10, whole Window 0.80. A configurable 25% worse-U margin gives nominal lower bounds 0.10, 0.125 and 1.00. Ground/basement boundary compatibility is pending; internal elements and infiltration are excluded. Original evidence below a bound is retained and flagged, not silently rewritten.

tabula.title: Swedish EPISCOPE/TABULA generic residential targets
tabula.note: Curated from the existing verified workbook extraction; source workbooks and detailed extraction are archived.

modern_extension.title: EPSM SE.06 extension
modern_extension.note: U06 = U05 * min(1, sqrt(U05/U03)); infiltration carries forward SE.05. Fixed modelling assumptions for 2006-present.

generic_equal_weight_blend.title: EPSM Generic synthetic equal-weight four-category blend
generic_equal_weight_blend.note: Each U-value anchor is the arithmetic mean of resolved SF, MF, Office and School values at SE.03 / Existing, with weight 0.25 each. Contributors and their source identifiers are recorded in each anchor note. Synthetic default for unspecified building function, not a measured or area/stock-weighted Swedish average. Shared Office/School internal references and shared SF/MF/Office basement references are not independent evidence. Retains MF curves and MF infiltration; only the reference-era/state values are guaranteed to equal the category means. Anchors are fixed snapshots, independent of later contributor edits, and must be refreshed deliberately.

proxy.title: EPSM internal-element proxy curves
proxy.note: Existing-state external-wall era ratios for internal walls; Existing-state ground-floor era ratios for intermediate floors. Renovation state is invariant.

poirazis_2008.title: Harris Poirazis, Single and Double Skin Glazed Office Buildings – Analyses of Energy Use and Indoor Climate
poirazis_2008.note: Designed 30%-glazed office reference representative of late-1990s construction (p.129), assigned to SE.05 / Existing. Applied U-values from Table 5.2; whole-window values from Tables 5.3–5.4. Not a measured national-stock average.

janson_2008_malmborg.title: Ulla Janson, Passive houses in Sweden – Experiences from design and construction phase; Villa Malmborg
janson_2008_malmborg.note: Villa Malmborg passive single-family house, constructed in 2006–2007, assigned to SE.06 / Existing. Reported DEROB-LTH simulation inputs, printed p.119 (PDF page 121), not measured national-stock averages. Stock representativeness and borrowed SF era curves are provisional assumptions. Passive new construction is not classified as an Advanced renovation. Exterior TABULA references, infiltration and the MF basement-wall proxy are retained.

sf_mf_basement_proxy.title: EPSM SF basement-wall proxy from residential MF
sf_mf_basement_proxy.note: Copied TABULA MF effective below-ground-wall anchor and borrowed MF curve. SF representativeness is assumed, not established by SF literature. Supplies an optional construction, not evidence that every single-family house has a basement. Copied anchor is independent of subsequent MF anchor edits. Original locator: TABULA.xlsm#'Calc.Building.Set'!HS2662.

office_mf_basement_proxy.title: EPSM Office basement-wall proxy from residential MF
office_mf_basement_proxy.note: Copied TABULA MF effective below-ground-wall anchor and borrowed MF curve. Office representativeness is assumed, not established by office literature. Supplies an optional construction, not evidence that every office has a basement. Original locator: TABULA.xlsm#'Calc.Building.Set'!HS2662.

steen_englund_2020_school.title: Steen Englund, Cehlin, Akander and Moshfegh, Measured and Simulated Energy Use in a Secondary School Building in Sweden—A Case Study of Validation, Airing, and Occupancy Behaviour
steen_englund_2020_school.note: Gävle school built 1961–1963, assigned to SE.02 / Existing. Table 1 assessed exterior U-values describe observed condition before planned major renovation, not pristine as-built construction: Table 5 reports pre-existing additional external-wall insulation. Thermal bridges are modelled separately.

cmf_1960_1_internal.title: EPSM archived CMF_1960_1 internal-element calculations, transcribed from Så byggdes husen
cmf_1960_1_internal.note: Calculated from Material_Database.xlsx layer stacks, not verified U-values quoted from the book. CMF_1960_1 is assumed to denote a 1960s typology and assigned to SE.02 / Existing; exact construction period, book edition and page remain pending source verification. The archive's construction_year 1960 was parsed from the identifier, not independently verified. Provisional references use simplified fixed internal surface resistances.

school_office_internal_proxy.title: EPSM School internal-element proxies copied from Office
school_office_internal_proxy.note: Copies Office Internal Wall and Intermediate Floor anchors from poirazis_2008, p.136 Table 5.2, at SE.05 / Existing. School representativeness is assumed. Uses the same MF Existing-state era proxy curves; renovation-state factors are 1.0. Copied anchors are independent of subsequent Office edits.

school_period_window_profile.title: User-supplied EPSM school period window profile
school_period_window_profile.version: Provided 2026-09-22; original model export and derivation not yet archived
school_period_window_profile.note: Representative whole-window U-values by construction period, not measured national stock values. Three BBR19 zones use the same construction. EPSM era values use equal-year overlap of the supplied period bins. SE.06 uses a fixed 2006–2026 snapshot (5, 10 and 6 years in the three source bins); years after 2026 are not independently evidenced. Existing, Standard and Advanced are independent state targets. See evidence/school_window_period_profile.md.

mfh_period_stacks.title: User-supplied representative MFH P04/P05/P06/P08 partition stacks
mfh_period_stacks.note: 70 mm timber/mineral-wool parallel zone, 15/85 area fraction, with 13 mm gypsum on each face. Nominal one-dimensional U uses EPSM material properties and partition surface films. Representative model, not a measured stock value.

sf_period_stacks.title: User-supplied SFH P01–P09 representative period stacks
sf_period_stacks.note: Modelled period families. Interior floor and partition nominal U are calculated from supplied depths and EPSM material/film assumptions, not TABULA or measured stock values.

office_period_stacks.title: User-supplied representative Office P01–P09 stacks
office_period_stacks.note: Interior-role nominal U comes from selected source depths and EPSM thermal properties/films, not from the Poirazis SE.05 reference or a stock survey.
